statements.text: P3: a difference in consciousness between two realizations at time $t$ results in a different future physical state, $C^\alpha_t \neq C^\beta_t \Rightarrow X^\alpha_{>t} \neq X^\beta_{>t}$. Without it, rival attributions produce identical physical evolution and no comparison can favor one.

sources.quote: absent causal efficacy, rival consciousness attributions produce identical physical evolution, and no comparison of the systems can favor one over the other
